name: FDC — Reentry & Transition Services
description: The Florida Department of Corrections coordinates statewide reentry planning, pre-release programming, and community transition services for people leaving FDC custody across all 67 counties. Reentry staff at the Tallahassee headquarters work with facility classification counselors, probation officers, and local nonprofits to connect returning citizens to housing, employment, MyACCESS benefits, and treatment before and after release. This office provides planning and referrals—not emergency shelter, cash assistance, or legal representation.
description_es: El Departamento de Correcciones de Florida coordina la planificación estatal de reinserción, programación previa a la liberación y servicios de transición comunitaria para personas que salen de custodia FDC en los 67 condados. El personal de reinserción en Tallahassee trabaja con consejeros de clasificación, oficiales de probatoria y organizaciones locales para conectar a ciudadanos que regresan con vivienda, empleo, beneficios MyACCESS y tratamiento.
eligibility: Individuals in FDC custody preparing for release or under community supervision; community partners seeking FDC reentry engagement.
eligibility_es: Personas en custodia FDC que se preparan para la liberación o bajo supervisión comunitaria; aliados comunitarios que buscan coordinación de reinserción.
notes: Visit fdc.myflorida.com/reentry for program overview; coordinate through facility reentry staff and assigned probation officer after release.
notes_es: Visite fdc.myflorida.com/reentry; coordine con el personal de reinserción de la instalación y el oficial de probatoria asignado.
hours: State office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Pre-release planning|Community reentry coordination|Partner referrals|Reentry resource navigation|Supervision linkage

name: FDC — Probation & Parole Services
description: FDC Probation and Parole Services supervises adults on felony probation, parole, and community control through circuit offices across Florida, connecting supervisees to employment, treatment, and housing resources as conditions of release. Probation officers coordinate with CareerSource Florida, DCF MyACCESS, local behavioral health providers, and reentry nonprofits in every county. Contact your assigned officer—not a walk-in benefits or emergency housing intake center.
description_es: Servicios de Probatoria y Libertad Condicional de FDC supervisa adultos en probatoria por delito grave, libertad condicional y control comunitario a través de oficinas de circuito en Florida, conectando a supervisados con empleo, tratamiento y vivienda según condiciones de liberación. Los oficiales coordinan con CareerSource Florida, MyACCESS DCF y proveedores locales.
eligibility: Adults under FDC probation, parole, or community control in Florida; report to assigned probation officer.
eligibility_es: Adultos bajo probatoria, libertad condicional o control comunitario de FDC en Florida; reporte al oficial de probatoria asignado.
notes: Find circuit office contacts at fdc.myflorida.com/probation; statewide information 850-488-5021.
notes_es: Encuentre contactos de oficinas de circuito en fdc.myflorida.com/probation; información estatal 850-488-5021.
hours: Circuit offices typically Monday–Friday business hours
services: Probation supervision|Parole reporting|Treatment referrals|Employment coordination|Reentry partner linkage

name: MyACCESS Florida
description: MyACCESS Florida is the state's official online portal for applying for and managing SNAP food assistance, Temporary Cash Assistance (TCA), and Florida Medicaid through the Department of Children and Families. Justice-involved Floridians can apply for health coverage and food support after release from FDC custody or county jails using the same account used by county DCF Family Resource Centers statewide. Online application and account management—not a crisis hotline or emergency shelter provider.
description_es: MyACCESS Florida es el portal en línea oficial del estado para solicitar y administrar asistencia alimentaria SNAP, Asistencia Temporal en Efectivo (TCA) y Medicaid de Florida a través del Departamento de Niños y Familias. Los floridanos en reinserción pueden solicitar cobertura de salud y apoyo alimentario después de la liberación usando la misma cuenta que las oficinas DCF del condado.
eligibility: Florida residents meeting income and household requirements for Medicaid, SNAP, or TCA; criminal record generally not a barrier to Medicaid and SNAP.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Florida que cumplan requisitos de ingresos para Medicaid, SNAP o TCA; los antecedentes penales generalmente no son barrera para Medicaid y SNAP.
notes: Apply online at myaccess.myflfamilies.com; call 850-300-4323 for DCF Customer Call Center; visit county Family Resource Center for in-person help.
notes_es: Solicite en myaccess.myflfamilies.com; llame al 850-300-4323; visite el Centro de Recursos Familiares del condado.
hours: Online 24/7; county DCF office hours vary
services: Medicaid application|SNAP enrollment|TCA application|Benefits account management|Document upload

name: AHCA — Florida Medicaid
description: The Agency for Health Care Administration administers Florida Medicaid managed care for eligible low-income Floridians through contracted health plans and managed medical assistance across all 67 counties. Returning citizens can enroll through MyACCESS Florida or county DCF offices to access primary care, behavioral health, and prescription coverage after release from FDC custody. AHCA is health coverage administration—not a walk-in clinic or emergency room.
description_es: La Agencia para la Administración de Atención Médica administra la atención administrada de Medicaid de Florida para floridanos elegibles de bajos ingresos a través de planes de salud contratados en los 67 condados. Los ciudadanos que regresan pueden inscribirse a través de MyACCESS Florida para acceder a atención primaria y salud conductual. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Florida residents meeting Medicaid income and categorical eligibility; enrollment through MyACCESS or DCF.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Florida que cumplan elegibilidad de ingresos de Medicaid; inscripción a través de MyACCESS o DCF.
notes: Apply at myaccess.myflfamilies.com; member services 877-254-1055; find your plan at ahca.myflorida.com.
notes_es: Solicite en myaccess.myflfamilies.com; servicios al miembro 877-254-1055; encuentre su plan en ahca.myflorida.com.
hours: State office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Medicaid enrollment|Health plan selection|Member services|Behavioral health plan navigation|Coverage verification

name: 211 Florida
description: 211 Florida is a free statewide information and referral service connecting residents to health and human services including housing, food, utilities, employment, and crisis support in all 67 Florida counties. United Way-supported navigators help callers find local programs by need and ZIP code through 211.org and by dialing 211 from any Florida phone. 211 Florida is a referral service—not a direct-service provider.
description_es: 211 Florida es un servicio gratuito de información y referencia estatal que conecta a residentes con servicios de salud y humanos incluyendo vivienda, alimentos, servicios públicos, empleo y apoyo en crisis en los 67 condados de Florida. Navegadores apoyados por United Way ayudan a encontrar programas locales por necesidad y código postal. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Open to all Florida residents; no criminal-record restrictions stated.
eligibility_es: Abierto a todos los residentes de Florida; sin restricciones de antecedentes indicadas.
notes: Dial 211 from any Florida phone; search resources online at 211.org; text your ZIP code to 898-211.
notes_es: Marque 211 desde cualquier teléfono de Florida; busque recursos en 211.org; envíe su código postal al 898-211.
hours: Available during published service hours; check 211.org
services: Information and referral|Crisis navigation|Housing referrals|Benefits navigation|Utility assistance referrals

name: Florida Legal Services — Statewide Intake
description: Florida Legal Services operates a statewide intake line connecting low-income Floridians—including returning citizens with civil legal needs after release from FDC custody—to regional legal aid offices for housing, benefits, family law, and expungement assistance. Intake specialists route callers to local programs such as Bay Area Legal Services, Community Legal Services of Mid-Florida, and Legal Services of Greater Miami. Civil legal aid—not criminal defense representation.
description_es: Florida Legal Services opera una línea de admisión estatal que conecta a floridanos de bajos ingresos—incluidos ciudadanos que regresan con necesidades legales civiles después de la liberación de custodia FDC—a oficinas regionales de ayuda legal para vivienda, beneficios, derecho familiar y asistencia de eliminación de antecedentes. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Low-income Florida residents with civil legal needs; income and case-type eligibility vary by regional program.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Florida de bajos ingresos con necesidades legales civiles; la elegibilidad varía según el programa regional.
notes: Call 850-385-7900 for statewide intake; visit floridalegal.org to find your regional legal aid office.
notes_es: Llame al 850-385-7900 para admisión estatal; visite floridalegal.org para encontrar su oficina regional.
hours: Monday–Friday business hours
services: Legal aid intake|Housing legal help|Benefits appeals|Family law referrals|Expungement guidance

name: CareerSource Florida
description: CareerSource Florida is the statewide workforce development network connecting job seekers—including justice-involved adults after FDC release—to WIOA-funded training, resume assistance, career coaching, and fair-chance employer navigation through 24 local CareerSource boards across all 67 counties. Returning citizens can register online and visit local career centers for employment services linked to DCF benefits and reentry nonprofits. Free core career services—not emergency cash or housing placement.
description_es: CareerSource Florida es la red estatal de desarrollo laboral que conecta buscadores de empleo—incluidos adultos con antecedentes penales después de la liberación FDC—a capacitación WIOA, ayuda con currículum y navegación de empleo de segunda oportunidad a través de 24 juntas locales CareerSource en los 67 condados. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Open to Florida job seekers including justice-involved individuals; core CareerSource services are free.
eligibility_es: Abierto a buscadores de empleo de Florida incluidas personas con antecedentes penales; servicios básicos gratuitos.
notes: Register at careersourceflorida.com; call 850-245-4500; find your local board by county.
notes_es: Regístrese en careersourceflorida.com; llame al 850-245-4500; encuentre su junta local por condado.
hours: Local career center hours vary; online registration 24/7
services: Job search assistance|WIOA training referrals|Resume coaching|Fair-chance employment|Career planning

name: Florida Division of Vocational Rehabilitation
description: The Florida Division of Vocational Rehabilitation helps Floridians with disabilities—including justice-involved individuals with documented disabilities—prepare for, obtain, and retain employment through counseling, training, assistive technology, and job placement across 15 area offices statewide. VR counselors coordinate with CareerSource Florida, FDC reentry staff, and local employers for fair-chance hiring. Vocational rehabilitation—not emergency benefits or housing.
description_es: La División de Rehabilitación Vocacional de Florida ayuda a floridanos con discapacidades—incluidas personas con antecedentes penales con discapacidades documentadas—a prepararse, obtener y mantener empleo a través de consejería, capacitación y colocación laboral en 15 oficinas de área en todo el estado. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Florida residents with physical or mental disabilities that create barriers to employment; justice-involved applicants with qualifying disabilities.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Florida con discapacidades físicas o mentales que crean barreras al empleo; solicitantes con antecedentes penales con discapacidades calificadas.
notes: Apply at rehabworks.org or call 850-245-4200; area offices serve all 67 counties.
notes_es: Solicite en rehabworks.org o llame al 850-245-4200; las oficinas de área sirven a los 67 condados.
hours: Area offices Monday–Friday business hours
services: Vocational counseling|Job placement|Training referrals|Assistive technology|Employer coordination

name: Florida Department of Veterans' Affairs
description: The Florida Department of Veterans' Affairs helps veterans and their families access federal VA benefits, state veterans preference in hiring, and county veterans service offices across all 67 counties. Justice-involved veterans leaving FDC custody can connect to VA healthcare, disability compensation, and housing programs through FDVA benefits counselors. Veterans benefits navigation—not emergency shelter or general population cash assistance.
description_es: El Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos de Florida ayuda a veteranos y sus familias a acceder a beneficios federales VA, preferencia de veteranos estatales en contratación y oficinas de servicios para veteranos del condado en los 67 condados. Los veteranos con antecedentes penales pueden conectarse con atención médica VA y programas de vivienda. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Florida veterans, service members, and eligible family members; DD-214 or military service documentation required.
eligibility_es: Veteranos de Florida, miembros del servicio y familiares elegibles; se requiere DD-214 o documentación de servicio militar.
notes: Find your county veterans service officer at floridavets.org; call 727-319-7440 for state headquarters.
notes_es: Encuentre su oficial de servicios para veteranos del condado en floridavets.org; llame al 727-319-7440.
hours: County VSO offices Monday–Friday; state office business hours
services: VA benefits counseling|Disability claims help|Healthcare enrollment|State hiring preference|Housing referrals

name: FLHSMV — Driver Licenses & ID
description: The Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles issues driver licenses, state identification cards, and driving records through tax collector and driver license service centers in all 67 counties. Returning citizens reestablishing identity after FDC release can obtain REAL ID-compliant credentials with required documents listed at flhsmv.gov. FLHSMV issues credentials—not probation reporting or benefits enrollment.
description_es: El Departamento de Seguridad de Carreteras y Vehículos Motorizados de Florida emite licencias de conducir, tarjetas de identificación estatal y registros de conducción a través de centros de servicio en los 67 condados. Los ciudadanos que regresan pueden obtener credenciales compatibles con REAL ID con los documentos requeridos en flhsmv.gov. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Florida residents meeting identity and lawful presence documentation requirements for driver license or ID card.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Florida que cumplan requisitos de documentación de identidad y presencia legal para licencia o tarjeta de identificación.
notes: Schedule appointments at flhsmv.gov/locations; bring required documents; tax collector offices vary by county.
notes_es: Programe citas en flhsmv.gov/locations; traiga documentos requeridos; las oficinas del recaudador varían por condado.
hours: Service center hours vary by county
services: Driver license issuance|State ID cards|Driving records|REAL ID credentials|Appointment scheduling

name: Florida Department of Health — Vital Records
description: The Florida Department of Health Bureau of Vital Statistics issues certified birth certificates, death certificates, and marriage records needed for MyACCESS Medicaid enrollment, FLHSMV identification, and employment background checks after release from FDC custody. Orders can be placed online, by mail, or in person at county health departments statewide. Vital records issuance—not clinical healthcare or benefits intake.
description_es: La Oficina de Estadísticas Vitales del Departamento de Salud de Florida emite certificados de nacimiento, defunción y matrimonio certificados necesarios para inscripción en Medicaid MyACCESS, identificación FLHSMV y verificaciones de antecedentes laborales después de la liberación de custodia FDC. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Individuals with legal right to request vital records per Florida statute; identity verification required.
eligibility_es: Personas con derecho legal a solicitar registros vitales según la ley de Florida; se requiere verificación de identidad.
notes: Order online at floridahealth.gov/certificates; processing times vary; county health departments accept walk-in requests.
notes_es: Ordene en línea en floridahealth.gov/certificates; los tiempos de procesamiento varían; los departamentos de salud del condado aceptan solicitudes presenciales.
hours: Online 24/7; county health department business hours
services: Birth certificate orders|Death certificate orders|Marriage records|Online ordering|Identity verification guidance

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline — Florida
description: The 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline provides free, confidential 24/7 support for people in mental health crisis, emotional distress, or suicidal thoughts across Florida including justice-involved individuals and families during reentry. Florida's 988 network connects callers to local crisis centers with mobile crisis teams and referrals to community behavioral health providers. Crisis support and referral—not housing placement or legal representation.
description_es: La Línea de Crisis y Prevención del Suicidio 988 proporciona apoyo gratuito y confidencial 24/7 para personas en crisis de salud mental, angustia emocional o pensamientos suicidas en Florida incluidas personas con antecedentes penales y familias durante la reinserción. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Open to anyone in crisis; no insurance or criminal-record restrictions.
eligibility_es: Abierto a cualquier persona en crisis; sin restricciones de seguro ni antecedentes penales.
notes: Dial or text 988; chat at 988lifeline.org; veterans press 1; Spanish services available.
notes_es: Marque o envíe mensaje al 988; chat en 988lifeline.org; veteranos presione 1; servicios en español disponibles.
services: Crisis counseling|Suicide prevention|Mobile crisis referrals|Emotional support|Warm handoffs

name: SAMHSA National Helpline
description: The SAMHSA National Helpline is a free, confidential 24/7 treatment referral service connecting Floridians—including returning citizens with substance use disorders—to local detox, outpatient, medication-assisted treatment, and recovery support providers across all 67 counties. Specialists help callers find Florida-licensed programs accepting Medicaid and sliding-fee care. Referral service—not direct treatment or emergency housing.
description_es: La Línea Nacional de SAMHSA es un servicio gratuito y confidencial de referencia a tratamiento 24/7 que conecta a floridanos—incluidos ciudadanos que regresan con trastornos por uso de sustancias—a proveedores locales de desintoxicación, tratamiento ambulatorio y apoyo en recuperación en los 67 condados. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Open to anyone seeking substance use treatment information; no insurance required to call.
eligibility_es: Abierto a cualquier persona que busque información sobre tratamiento de uso de sustancias; no se requiere seguro para llamar.
notes: Call 1-800-662-HELP (4357); TTY 1-800-487-4889; Spanish-language support available.
notes_es: Llame al 1-800-662-HELP (4357); TTY 1-800-487-4889; soporte en español disponible.
services: Treatment referrals|Provider locator|Medicaid program navigation|Crisis resource connection|Recovery support info

name: FindTreatment.gov
description: FindTreatment.gov is SAMHSA's searchable directory of licensed substance use treatment facilities across Florida, allowing returning citizens and families to filter by location, treatment type, payment options including Medicaid, and services such as outpatient, residential, and medication-assisted treatment. The tool supplements local referrals from FDC probation officers, courts, and Florida community behavioral health providers. Online directory—not a crisis hotline.
description_es: FindTreatment.gov es el directorio buscable de SAMHSA de instalaciones de tratamiento de uso de sustancias con licencia en Florida, permitiendo a ciudadanos que regresan y familias filtrar por ubicación, tipo de tratamiento, opciones de pago incluido Medicaid y servicios ambulatorios o residenciales. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Open to anyone seeking treatment facility information; facility admission criteria vary.
eligibility_es: Abierto a cualquier persona que busque información de instalaciones de tratamiento; los criterios de admisión varían.
notes: Search by ZIP code at findtreatment.gov; call SAMHSA helpline 1-800-662-4357 for navigator help.
notes_es: Busque por código postal en findtreatment.gov; llame a la línea SAMHSA 1-800-662-4357 para ayuda de navegación.
hours: Online 24/7
services: Treatment facility search|Payment option filters|Outpatient listings|Residential listings|MAT provider locator

name: DCF — ACCESS Customer Call Center
description: The Florida Department of Children and Families ACCESS Customer Call Center helps residents statewide—including returning citizens—apply for SNAP, TCA, and Medicaid by phone, resolve MyACCESS account issues, and schedule interviews when county Family Resource Centers are unavailable. Counselors guide callers through document requirements and connect them to local DCF offices for verification. Phone benefits support—not emergency shelter or legal aid.
description_es: El Centro de Llamadas de Atención al Cliente ACCESS del DCF ayuda a residentes en todo el estado—incluidos ciudadanos que regresan—a solicitar SNAP, TCA y Medicaid por teléfono, resolver problemas de cuenta MyACCESS y programar entrevistas cuando las oficinas del condado no están disponibles. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Florida residents applying for or managing SNAP, TCA, or Medicaid benefits.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Florida que solicitan o administran beneficios SNAP, TCA o Medicaid.
notes: Call 850-300-4323; also apply online at myaccess.myflfamilies.com; multilingual support available.
notes_es: Llame al 850-300-4323; también solicite en myaccess.myflfamilies.com; soporte multilingüe disponible.
hours: Monday–Friday extended hours; check myflfamilies.com
services: Phone application help|Account troubleshooting|Interview scheduling|Document guidance|Benefits status checks

name: Florida Housing Finance Corporation
description: The Florida Housing Finance Corporation administers statewide affordable housing programs including rental assistance, homeless continuum-of-care coordination, and developer-funded affordable units for low-income Floridians including returning citizens rebuilding stable housing after FDC release. Florida Housing connects renters and service providers to local housing finance authorities and SHIP county programs. Housing finance and referrals—not emergency walk-in shelter.
description_es: La Corporación de Finanzas de Vivienda de Florida administra programas estatales de vivienda asequible incluyendo asistencia de alquiler, coordinación de continuo de atención para personas sin hogar y unidades asequibles para floridanos de bajos ingresos incluidos ciudadanos que regresan que reconstruyen vivienda estable después de la liberación FDC.
eligibility: Low-income Florida households; program-specific eligibility for rental assistance and affordable units.
eligibility_es: Hogares de bajos ingresos de Florida; elegibilidad específica del programa para asistencia de alquiler y unidades asequibles.
notes: Search rental resources at floridahousing.org; contact local SHIP office for county rental assistance.
notes_es: Busque recursos de alquiler en floridahousing.org; contacte la oficina SHIP local para asistencia de alquiler del condado.
hours: State office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Affordable housing listings|Rental assistance programs|SHIP county referrals|Homeless housing coordination|Developer program info

name: Florida Rights Restoration Coalition
description: Florida Rights Restoration Coalition advocates for returning citizens and helps eligible Floridians restore voting rights and navigate civic reintegration after felony convictions. Staff connect justice-involved adults from FDC custody and Orange County jails to MyACCESS benefits, CareerSource employment, and local reentry partners across Orlando / Orange County. Direct program services—not emergency cash assistance or a general probation reporting office unless noted.
description_es: Florida Rights Restoration Coalition aboga por ciudadanos que regresan y ayuda a floridanos elegibles a restaurar derechos de voto y navegar la reintegración cívica después de condenas por delito grave. El personal conecta a adultos con antecedentes penales de custodia FDC y cárceles del condado Orange con beneficios MyACCESS, empleo CareerSource y aliados locales de reinserción en Orlando / Orange County.
eligibility: Returning citizens seeking rights restoration and civic reintegration support.
eligibility_es: Ciudadanos que regresan que buscan restauración de derechos y apoyo de reintegración cívica.
notes: Visit floridarrc.com for workshops and clinics.
notes_es: Visite floridarrc.com.
hours: Monday–Friday
services: Rights restoration help|Voting rights|Advocacy|Community workshops|Legal clinic referrals

name: Florida Department of Education — Adult Education
description: The Florida Department of Education coordinates adult education and GED preparation programs through school districts and community colleges in all 67 counties, helping returning citizens earn high school equivalency credentials for CareerSource employment and vocational training. Justice-involved adults can enroll in free or low-cost adult education classes at local career centers and community colleges listed at fldoe.org. Education programs—not probation reporting or benefits intake.
description_es: El Departamento de Educación de Florida coordina programas de educación para adultos y preparación GED a través de distritos escolares y colegios comunitarios en los 67 condados, ayudando a ciudadanos que regresan a obtener credenciales de equivalencia de secundaria para empleo CareerSource y capacitación vocacional. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Florida adults age 16+ seeking GED or adult basic education; justice-involved learners welcome at most sites.
eligibility_es: Adultos de Florida de 16+ años que buscan GED o educación básica para adultos; estudiantes con antecedentes penales bienvenidos en la mayoría de sitios.
notes: Find local adult education programs at fldoe.org; contact your county school district adult education office.
notes_es: Encuentre programas locales de educación para adultos en fldoe.org; contacte la oficina de educación para adultos de su distrito escolar.
hours: Class schedules vary by provider
services: GED preparation|Adult basic education|ESL classes|Career pathway planning|Testing center referrals

name: Feeding Florida — Statewide Food Bank Network
description: Feeding Florida is the statewide network of food banks—including Feeding South Florida, Feeding Tampa Bay, and Second Harvest of Central Florida—distributing groceries and meals to partner pantries in all 67 counties for families including returning citizens rebuilding food security after release from FDC custody. The network connects callers to local pantries by ZIP code when SNAP benefits are pending through MyACCESS. Food distribution network—not a walk-in benefits office.
description_es: Feeding Florida es la red estatal de bancos de alimentos que distribuye comestibles y comidas a despensas asociadas en los 67 condados para familias incluidos ciudadanos que regresan que reconstruyen seguridad alimentaria después de la liberación de custodia FDC. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Food-insecure Florida residents; pantry eligibility varies; no criminal-record restrictions at network level.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Florida con inseguridad alimentaria; la elegibilidad de despensa varía; sin restricciones de antecedentes a nivel de red.
notes: Find your regional food bank at feedingflorida.org; call 2-1-1 for nearest pantry; apply for SNAP at myaccess.myflfamilies.com.
notes_es: Encuentre su banco de alimentos regional en feedingflorida.org; llame al 2-1-1; solicite SNAP en myaccess.myflfamilies.com.
hours: Pantry hours vary by location
services: Food pantry referrals|Mobile pantry schedules|SNAP application guidance|Emergency food boxes|Partner agency network

name: Florida Office of the Public Defender — Civil Legal Referrals
description: While Florida public defenders handle criminal defense, the statewide public defender system publishes civil legal referral guides connecting indigent clients after case closure—including returning citizens—to regional legal aid for eviction defense, benefits appeals, and record-sealing resources. Contact your regional legal aid office through Florida Legal Services intake for civil matters after criminal representation ends. Criminal defense during active cases; civil referrals after closure.
description_es: Aunque los defensores públicos de Florida manejan defensa penal, el sistema estatal publica guías de referencia legal civil que conectan a clientes indigentes después del cierre del caso—incluidos ciudadanos que regresan—a ayuda legal regional para defensa de desalojo, apelaciones de beneficios y recursos de sellado de antecedentes. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Former public defender clients and low-income Floridians with civil legal needs; active criminal cases handled separately.
eligibility_es: Ex clientes de defensor público y floridanos de bajos ingresos con necesidades legales civiles; casos penales activos manejados por separado.
notes: For civil legal help after case closure call Florida Legal Services 850-385-7900; public defender offices do not handle civil cases.
notes_es: Para ayuda legal civil después del cierre del caso llame a Florida Legal Services 850-385-7900.
hours: Office Monday–Friday business hours
services: Civil legal referrals|Record-sealing resources|Benefits appeal guidance|Eviction defense referrals|Legal aid routing

name: Camillus House — Permanent Supportive Housing
description: Camillus House operates permanent supportive housing, emergency shelter, and comprehensive reentry services for homeless adults in Miami-Dade County including justice-involved individuals returning from FDC custody and Miami-Dade County jails. Case managers connect residents to CareerSource South Florida, MyACCESS benefits, and Jackson Health System primary care while stabilizing long-term leases across Miami.
description_es: Camillus House opera vivienda de apoyo permanente, refugio de emergencia y servicios integrales de reinserción para adultos sin hogar en el condado Miami-Dade incluidas personas con antecedentes penales que regresan de custodia FDC y cárceles del condado Miami-Dade. Contact the program directly to confirm current hours, eligibility, and intake requirements before visiting in person.
eligibility: Homeless adults in Miami-Dade County; justice-involved participants per program policy.
eligibility_es: Adultos sin hogar en el condado Miami-Dade; participantes con antecedentes penales según política.
notes: Call 305-374-1065 for intake; coordinated entry for shelter; pairs with Legal Services of Greater Miami.
notes_es: Llame al 305-374-1065 para admisión.
hours: Shelter 24/7; offices Monday–Friday
services: Permanent supportive housing|Emergency shelter|Case management|Benefits navigation|Employment referrals
